decisions.reason: Report names the running dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 from running-processes.txt as the process that loaded koffi.node at startup, explains the loaded native DLL stays OS-locked until that process exits so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY.

Explains a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the host process owning koffi.node stays alive, and gives an ordered procedure: stop/verify all dsh node processes, install from an external terminal, then restart and verify — without prescribing killing unrelated processes.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: an unpinned install resolves the bare package name to the latest dist-tag, which points to 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, so the install silently replaced alpha.4 with an older rc.2 instead of preserving/upgrading it; explicitly identifies latest as the followed tag.

Provides the exact pinned command npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, then restart and verify dsh --version prints alpha.5; @alpha is only discussed as a mutable alternative.

Advises README authors to pin the exact host version in any install command that also installs dsh rather than letting it silently follow latest over an existing prerelease, plus stop-first warnings and post-install version verification; the unpinned command appears only as the diagnosed trap.
